summary: Verified DJ END LIVE button refactor in PublisherControls. All requested behaviors work end-to-end.

test_results.END_LIVE_button_full_width_visible: PASS — button has data-testid=pub-leave-btn, w-full, h-11 (44px), width 478px, visible text 'END LIVE' (rendered uppercase via shadcn Button 'uppercase' class over source 'End Live').
test_results.three_icon_controls_present: PASS — pub-toggle-mic-btn, pub-toggle-cam-btn, pub-flip-cam-btn all present in a grid-cols-3 above END LIVE.
test_results.click_END_LIVE_flow: PASS — POST /api/livekit/stream/stop fired (status 200), LiveKitBroadcaster unmounted (dj-camera-preview gone), UI returned to pre-broadcast state (dj-go-live-camera-btn visible again).
test_results.guest_leave_stage_label: PASS by code review — StageGrid renders <PublisherControls onLeave={onLeaveStage} label="Leave Stage" /> without isHost, so pub-leave-btn text = 'Leave Stage'. Component uses {isHost ? 'End Live' : label}. Not exercised live due to single-browser sandbox constraint.
test_results.regression_broadcast_all_and_checkins: Not re-tested this iteration; iteration_59 covered these and code paths untouched.

critical_code_review_comments: LiveKitStream.jsx uses window.location.origin for API_URL instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — inconsistent with repo pattern (works because same-origin, but recommend switching for consistency).

Source text 'End Live' is rendered uppercase only via the shadcn Button 'uppercase' utility class. If a future Button variant drops that class, the requested 'END LIVE' visual would silently degrade to 'End Live'. Consider hardcoding 'END LIVE' or wrapping in a span with uppercase class.
PublisherControls: `label` prop unused when isHost=true (host label is hardcoded 'End Live'). Minor API smell but harmless.
